name: Chicken Thighs with Artichokes & Lemon
steps: Sear chicken in oil; remove. Sauté garlic; deglaze with wine.
Add broth, artichokes, lemon slices, thyme; return chicken.
Roast at 400°F 20 minutes; parsley.

name: Chicken & Cauliflower Rice Casserole (Broccoli Cheddar)
steps: Cook and dice chicken; steam broccoli.
Mix yogurt, milk, Dijon, spices, half the cheddar; fold in chicken, cauliflower rice, broccoli.
Top cheddar; bake at 375°F 25 minutes.

name: Turkey Zucchini Burgers with Feta
steps: Grate and squeeze zucchini; mix with turkey, feta, garlic, oregano, egg, almond flour, salt.
Form 4 patties; pan-fry in oil 6–7 minutes per side.
Serve in lettuce with tomato and yogurt.

name: Chicken Zucchini Stir-Fry with Basil
steps: Stir-fry chicken in oil with garlic and jalapeño.
Add zucchini 3 minutes; add fish sauce, tamari, sweetener.
Toss with basil off heat.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Alfredo Bake
steps: Steam half the cauliflower; blend with milk, parmesan, cream cheese, garlic, nutmeg for sauce.
Roast remaining florets; sear diced chicken; wilt spinach.
Combine with sauce in a dish; top mozzarella; bake at 375°F 20 minutes.

name: Lemon Pepper Chicken with Green Beans (Sheet Pan)
steps: Toss chicken and beans with oil, lemon zest, pepper, garlic, salt.
Roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Lemon juice.

name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Cups
steps: Brown turkey with onion and seasoning in oil.
Spoon into lettuce.
Top pico, avocado, cheddar, yogurt.

name: Chicken Skewers with Peanut Slaw
steps: Marinate chicken in half the tamari, lime, garlic; skewer; grill 12 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter, remaining tamari, lime, vinegar, sriracha, water; toss with slaw.
Serve with cilantro and peanuts.

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken (Yogurt)
steps: Sear chicken; remove. Sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes.
Add broth; reduce; stir in yogurt and parmesan off heat; wilt spinach.
Return chicken; simmer 5 minutes.

name: Chicken Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry chicken strips in oil; remove.
Stir-fry cabbage, carrot, garlic, ginger 5 minutes.
Return chicken with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; green onion.

name: Chicken Enchilada Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop.
Mix chicken, beans, half the sauce, half the cheese; fill.
Top remaining sauce and cheese; bake at 400°F 25 minutes; green onion, cilantro, yogurt.

name: Turkey & Vegetable Skillet with Quinoa
steps: Brown turkey with onion, garlic in oil.
Add zucchini, pepper, tomatoes, seasoning; simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in quinoa; parmesan.

name: Chicken Cutlets with Arugula Salad
steps: Pound chicken thin; dip in egg then almond flour-parmesan; pan-fry in oil 3–4 minutes per side.
Toss arugula and tomatoes with lemon and a little oil.
Pile salad on cutlets.

name: Chicken Kale Sweet Potato Skillet
steps: Brown chicken pieces in oil; remove.
Sauté sweet potato and onion covered 8 minutes; add garlic, paprika.
Return chicken with kale and broth; cook 6 minutes.

name: Ginger Garlic Chicken with Snap Peas
steps: Toss chicken with arrowroot; stir-fry in oil; remove.
Stir-fry snap peas, pepper, ginger, garlic 3 minutes.
Return chicken with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil.

name: Turkey Spinach Feta Meatloaf Muffins
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Divide into 12 muffin cups.
Bake at 375°F 22–25 minutes.

name: Chicken Poblano Cauliflower Rice Bowl
steps: Char poblano and onion in oil; add chicken pieces and cumin; cook through.
Sauté cauliflower rice; warm beans.
Bowl; lime, cotija, cilantro.

name: Chicken & Broccoli Sheet Pan with Sesame
steps: Toss chicken and broccoli with tamari, oils, garlic, ginger, vinegar.
Roast at 425°F 20–22 minutes.
Sesame, green onion.

name: Herb Chicken Salad Stuffed Avocados
steps: Mix chicken, yogurt, Dijon, celery, herbs, lemon, salt.
Halve avocados.
Fill.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Shawarma Sheet Pan
steps: Toss chicken and cauliflower with spices, garlic, lemon, oil, salt.
Roast at 425°F 25 minutes.
Serve with yogurt-tahini sauce and parsley.

name: Chicken Mushroom Zoodle Skillet
steps: Sear chicken; remove. Sauté mushrooms, garlic, thyme.
Add broth; reduce; yogurt and parmesan off heat.
Toss with zoodles and chicken 2 minutes.

name: Buffalo Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix turkey, egg, almond flour, minced celery, garlic powder, salt; form meatballs; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Toss with hot sauce melted with butter.
Serve with yogurt-blue cheese and carrot sticks.

name: Chicken Curry Lettuce Cups
steps: Brown chicken with onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder in oil.
Add peas and a splash of water; cook 3 minutes.
Fill lettuce; top yogurt, cilantro, lime.

name: Chicken Thighs with Roasted Cabbage Wedges & Mustard
steps: Rub chicken with half the Dijon, garlic, thyme, oil, salt.
Brush cabbage wedges with remaining oil and Dijon.
Roast everything at 425°F 30–35 minutes; drizzle vinegar.

name: Chicken Salad Lettuce Boats with Pesto
steps: Mix chicken, pesto, yogurt.
Fold in tomato and mozzarella.
Fill romaine leaves; pine nuts.

name: Cod with Chorizo-Style Turkey Crumbles & Kale
steps: Brown turkey with paprika, cumin, garlic (quick chorizo); add kale, beans, broth; simmer 5 minutes.
Sear cod in oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve cod over the kale-bean mix with lemon.

name: Shrimp & Asparagus Lemon Skillet
steps: Sauté asparagus in oil 4 minutes.
Add garlic, shrimp, butter; cook 3 minutes.
Lemon, parsley, pepper flakes.

name: Baked Salmon with Pesto & Zucchini
steps: Spread pesto on salmon; surround with zucchini and tomatoes tossed in oil.
Bake at 400°F 14 minutes.
Lemon.

name: Tilapia Tacos with Avocado Crema
steps: Season tilapia; sear in oil; flake.
Blend avocado, yogurt, lime.
Fill tortillas with cabbage, fish, crema, cilantro.

name: Shrimp Stir-Fry with Bok Choy & Mushrooms
steps: Stir-fry shiitake, garlic, ginger in oil; add bok choy 3 minutes.
Add shrimp 3 minutes.
Tamari, vinegar, sesame oil.

name: Salmon Patties with Lemon Yogurt
steps: Mix salmon, eggs, almond flour, green onion, dill, lemon zest; form 8 patties.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt with lemon juice; serve over greens.

name: Mediterranean Shrimp & Feta Bake
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add tomatoes, oregano, olives; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in shrimp; top feta.
Bake at 400°F 12 minutes; parsley, pepper flakes.

name: Blackened Mahi-Mahi with Cilantro Lime Cauliflower Rice
steps: Rub fish with spices; sear in oil 4 minutes per side.
Sauté cauliflower rice; lime, cilantro.
Serve with avocado.

name: Tuna Zucchini Fritters
steps: Grate and squeeze zucchini; mix with tuna, eggs, almond flour, parmesan, green onion, dill.
Pan-fry spoonfuls in oil 3–4 minutes per side.
Serve with lemon yogurt.

name: Shrimp Cauliflower Risotto
steps: Sauté garlic in oil; add cauliflower rice, wine, broth; simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and cream cheese until creamy.
Sauté shrimp separately; fold in; lemon, parsley.

name: Salmon Cauliflower Rice Bowl with Sriracha Mayo
steps: Roast salmon 12 minutes; flake.
Sauté cauliflower rice with tamari.
Bowl with edamame, cucumber, avocado, salmon; sriracha mayo, sesame, green onion.

name: Cod with Lemon Butter & Spinach
steps: Sear cod in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
Melt butter with garlic, lemon, capers.
Wilt spinach; serve cod over spinach with sauce.

name: Garlic Shrimp Lettuce Cups with Avocado
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in oil 3 minutes; lime.
Fill lettuce cups.
Avocado, cilantro, pepper flakes.

name: Trout with Almond Green Beans & Lemon
steps: Roast trout with oil and salt 12 minutes.
Sauté green beans with garlic; add butter and almonds.
Lemon.

name: Shrimp Zoodle Alfredo (Cauliflower Sauce)
steps: Simmer cauliflower and garlic in milk; blend with parmesan, cream cheese, nutmeg, salt.
Sauté shrimp in oil; add zoodles 2 minutes.
Toss with sauce.

name: Seared Tuna Nicoise Lettuce Bowls
steps: Sear tuna in avocado oil 1–2 minutes per side; slice. Boil eggs; blanch beans.
Whisk olive oil, Dijon, vinegar.
Arrange lettuce, tuna, eggs, beans, tomato, olives; dressing.

name: Crab Stuffed Portobellos
steps: Brush caps with oil; roast 8 minutes.
Mix crab, cream cheese, yogurt, green onion, Old Bay, lemon.
Fill; top parmesan; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Salmon with Mango Avocado Salsa
steps: Rub salmon with oil, cumin, salt; roast at 400°F 12 minutes.
Dice mango, avocado, onion, jalapeño; toss with cilantro, lime.
Top salmon with salsa.

name: Shrimp & Sausage Cauliflower Jambalaya
steps: Brown sausage; sauté onion, pepper, celery, garlic 6 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, seasoning, cauliflower rice; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp 4 minutes; green onion.

name: Halibut with Roasted Tomatoes & White Beans
steps: Roast tomatoes with garlic and half the oil at 425°F 15 minutes; stir in beans.
Sear halibut in remaining oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve fish over tomato-beans; basil, lemon.

name: Scallops with Bacon & Brussels Sprouts
steps: Crisp bacon; sauté shredded sprouts in the fat with garlic 8 minutes.
Sear scallops in oil 90 seconds per side.
Serve over sprouts with bacon and lemon.

name: Tuna & Egg Salad Stuffed Peppers
steps: Hard-boil eggs; chop.
Mix with tuna, yogurt, Dijon, celery, dill, salt.
Fill halved peppers.

name: Mussels with Coconut Curry Broth
steps: Fry curry paste, garlic, ginger in oil; add coconut milk and bok choy; simmer 3 minutes.
Add mussels; cover 5–6 minutes until open.
Lime, fish sauce, cilantro.

name: Beef & Zucchini Skillet with Tomatoes
steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic in oil.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, seasoning; simmer 10 minutes.
Parmesan.

name: Pork Chops with Apple Cabbage Slaw
steps: Season chops with thyme; sear in oil 4–5 minutes per side.
Toss shredded cabbage and apple with yogurt, Dijon, vinegar.
Serve chops with slaw.

name: Beef Lettuce Cups with Kimchi
steps: Brown beef with garlic and ginger in oil; add tamari, gochujang, sesame oil.
Fill lettuce with beef and kimchi.
Green onion, sesame.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Green Beans & Almonds
steps: Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, rosemary, salt; roast at 425°F 18 minutes; rest.
Sauté green beans with garlic; add almonds and lemon.
Slice pork; serve.

name: Beef Chili-Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown beef with onion and spices; add beans, tomatoes; simmer 8 minutes.
Fill; top cheddar; bake at 400°F 18 minutes; yogurt.

name: Pork & Zucchini Stir-Fry with Basil
steps: Brown pork with garlic and jalapeño.
Add zucchini 3 minutes; fish sauce, tamari, sweetener.
Basil off heat.

name: Beef & Cauliflower Rice Burrito Bowls
steps: Brown beef with seasoning in oil.
Sauté cauliflower rice with lime.
Bowl with beans, pico, avocado, cheddar, romaine, yogurt.

name: Lamb Meatballs with Cucumber Yogurt & Zoodles
steps: Mix lamb, garlic, oregano, mint, egg, almond flour, salt; form meatballs; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Sauté zoodles in oil.
Serve with cucumber-dill yogurt and lemon.

name: Pork Chops with Mushroom Gravy (Yogurt)
steps: Sear chops; remove. Sauté mushrooms, onion, garlic, thyme; add broth; reduce; stir in yogurt and Dijon off heat.
Steam and mash cauliflower.
Serve chops with gravy over mash.

name: Beef Kofta Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mix beef, onion, parsley, garlic, spices, salt; form kofta; grill 12 minutes.
Whisk yogurt, tahini, lemon.
Serve in lettuce with tomato and sauce.

name: Pork Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown pork with garlic and ginger; remove.
Scramble eggs; add carrot, cauliflower rice 5 minutes.
Return pork with peas, tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Steak & Broccoli Sheet Pan
steps: Toss broccoli with half the oil, garlic, salt; roast at 450°F 10 minutes.
Add steak cubes tossed with remaining oil, paprika, tamari; roast 6–8 minutes.
Lemon.

name: Italian Beef & Spinach Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, seasoning; add spinach and marinara.
Fill; top mozzarella; bake at 400°F 22 minutes.

name: Pork Souvlaki Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Marinate pork cubes; skewer; grill 12 minutes.
Sauté cauliflower rice with lemon and oregano.
Bowl with cucumber, tomato, onion, feta, yogurt-dill.

name: Cauliflower Chickpea Coconut Curry
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder in oil.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk; simmer 15 minutes.
Spinach, lime, cilantro.

name: Zucchini Noodle Pad Thai with Egg & Edamame
steps: Scramble eggs in oil; push aside.
Add zoodles, garlic, tamari, lime, sweetener, sriracha; toss 2 minutes.
Edamame, sprouts, green onion, peanuts.

name: Spinach & Mushroom Tofu Scramble Bowl
steps: Sauté mushrooms and garlic in oil.
Crumble tofu in with turmeric, nutritional yeast, salt; cook 6 minutes; wilt spinach.
Bowl with avocado and tomato.

name: Lentil & Vegetable Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Sauté onion, garlic, zucchini; add lentils, tomatoes, cumin.
Fill; top feta; bake at 400°F 20 minutes; parsley.

name: Chickpea Shawarma Bowls
steps: Toss chickpeas with spices, garlic, half the oil; roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with cucumber, tomato, onion; tahini-lemon sauce; parsley.

name: Eggplant & Chickpea Stew
steps: Sauté eggplant cubes in oil until golden; remove.
Sauté onion, garlic, spices; add tomatoes, chickpeas, eggplant.
Simmer 20 minutes; parsley, lemon.

name: Tofu Broccoli Cauliflower Rice Bowl with Tahini
steps: Roast tofu and broccoli with oil at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Whisk tahini, lemon, tamari, garlic, water; bowl; sesame.

name: Greek Egg & Feta Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop; roast 10 minutes.
Whisk eggs, feta, chopped tomato, dill, green onion, salt.
Fill; bake at 375°F 18 minutes until set.

name: Black Bean Cauliflower Rice Skillet
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic, spices in oil.
Add cauliflower rice, beans, tomatoes; simmer 8 minutes.
Cheddar, avocado, cilantro, lime.

name: Tempeh Lettuce Wraps with Ginger
steps: Crumble tempeh; brown in oil with ginger and garlic.
Add water chestnuts, tamari, vinegar, sesame oil.
Fill lettuce; green onion, sriracha.

name: Mushroom & White Bean Ragu over Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes.
Sear mushrooms in oil; add onion, garlic, wine, tomatoes, beans, rosemary; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over squash with parmesan.

name: Cauliflower Fried 'Rice' with Egg & Kimchi
steps: Stir-fry cauliflower rice and kimchi in oil 5 minutes.
Scramble eggs in; tamari, sesame oil.
Green onion, nori.

name: Broccoli & Cheddar Egg White Frittata
steps: Sauté onion and chopped broccoli in oil in an ovenproof skillet 5 minutes.
Pour in egg whites and eggs whisked with Dijon and salt; top cheddar.
Bake at 375°F 15–18 minutes.

name: Tofu Katsu-Style (Almond Crust) with Cabbage
steps: Press tofu; slice slabs; dip in egg then almond flour-sesame; pan-fry in oil 3 minutes per side.
Toss shredded cabbage with vinegar.
Serve with tamari-sweetener dipping sauce; green onion.

name: Lentil Walnut 'Taco' Lettuce Cups
steps: Pulse lentils and walnuts coarsely.
Sauté onion, garlic; add lentil mix, seasoning, tomato paste, splash of water; cook 6 minutes.
Fill romaine; avocado, salsa, cilantro.

name: Greek Yogurt Egg Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hard-boil eggs; chop; mix with yogurt, Dijon, chives, celery, salt.
Hollow tomatoes.
Fill.

name: Cauliflower & Chickpea Shawarma Wraps (Low-Carb Tortilla)
steps: Roast cauliflower and chickpeas with spices, garlic, oil at 425°F 22 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon, water.
Fill tortillas; cucumber, tomato, parsley.

name: Miso Tofu Soup Bowl with Greens
steps: Simmer broth with ginger and shiitake 5 minutes; add bok choy, tofu 3 minutes.
Poach eggs in the broth 3 minutes.
Whisk in miso off heat; green onion, sesame oil.

name: Egg White Spinach Feta Wrap
steps: Wilt spinach in oil; add egg whites; scramble.
Add feta and tomato.
Roll in tortilla.

name: Pumpkin Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend pumpkin, eggs, protein, oats, spice, baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in oil 2–3 minutes per side.
Yogurt, pecans.

name: Sausage Egg & Cheese Breakfast Bowl (Cauliflower)
steps: Brown sausage with pepper; add cauliflower rice 4 minutes.
Scramble eggs in; cheddar.
Green onion, hot sauce.

name: Blueberry Almond Chia Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, chia, milk, yogurt, vanilla.
Refrigerate overnight.
Blueberries, almonds.

name: Egg & Avocado Breakfast Tacos (Low-Carb)
steps: Scramble eggs in oil.
Warm tortillas; fill with eggs, avocado, salsa.
Cotija, cilantro.

name: Cottage Cheese Scramble with Chives
steps: Whisk eggs with cottage cheese and pepper.
Cook in butter over low heat, stirring, for soft curds.
Chives; tomato on the side.

name: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Walnuts, Cinnamon & Pear
steps: Bowl yogurt.
Top diced pear, walnuts, chia.
Cinnamon.

name: Smoked Salmon Scramble
steps: Whisk eggs; cook in butter low and slow.
Fold in cream cheese and salmon at the end.
Chives, pepper.

name: Veggie Egg White Omelet with Hummus
steps: Sauté mushrooms and spinach in oil.
Pour egg whites; cook until set; fold with tomato.
Serve with hummus and za'atar.

name: Chocolate Chia Protein Overnight Oats
steps: Whisk protein, cocoa, sweetener into milk; stir oats and chia.
Refrigerate overnight.
Raspberries.

name: Turkey Sausage Egg Muffins with Spinach
steps: Brown crumbled sausage.
Divide sausage, spinach, pepper, cheddar into 12 oiled cups; pour whisked eggs with milk and salt.
Bake at 350°F 20 minutes.

name: Avocado Cottage Cheese Toast
steps: Toast bread.
Spread cottage cheese; top sliced avocado.
Seasoning, pepper flakes.

name: Strawberry Protein Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend strawberries, yogurt, protein, milk until thick.
Bowl; top chia, almonds, coconut.

name: Mushroom Spinach Egg White Cups
steps: Sauté mushrooms in oil; add spinach.
Divide into 8 oiled cups; pour egg whites with parmesan, garlic powder, salt.
Bake at 350°F 18 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk peanut butter, sweetener, vanilla into milk; stir chia.
Refrigerate 4+ hours.
Strawberries.

name: Southwest Veggie Egg Scramble
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, jalapeño with cumin in oil; add beans.
Add whisked eggs; scramble; cheddar.
Salsa, cilantro.

name: Cinnamon Cottage Cheese Pancakes
steps: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, oats, cinnamon, vanilla, baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in oil 2–3 minutes per side.
Yogurt, blueberries.

name: Ham & Swiss Egg Cups
steps: Line 6 muffin cups with ham slices.
Add spinach and cheese; crack an egg into each; pepper.
Bake at 375°F 13–15 minutes.

name: Tofu Veggie Breakfast Burrito (Low-Carb)
steps: Crumble tofu; sauté with pepper, turmeric, cumin, nutritional yeast; wilt spinach.
Fill tortillas with tofu, salsa, avocado.
Roll.

name: Salmon Kale Salad with Lemon Tahini
steps: Roast salmon 12 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic, water, salt; massage into kale.
Top cucumber, radish, avocado, salmon, hemp.

name: Chicken Cucumber Avocado Salad
steps: Chop chicken, cucumber, avocado, tomato, onion.
Toss with cilantro, lime, oil, salt.

name: Tuna Kale Caesar
steps: Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, anchovy, garlic, oil.
Massage into kale.
Top tuna, parmesan, pumpkin seeds.

name: Shrimp & Quinoa Mediterranean Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; cool.
Toss quinoa, cucumber, tomato, olives, parsley with lemon, oil, oregano.
Add shrimp and feta.

name: Egg & Asparagus Spring Salad
steps: Soft-boil eggs 7 minutes; blanch asparagus 3 minutes.
Whisk oil, Dijon, lemon.
Toss greens, asparagus, radish; top halved eggs, parmesan, chives.

name: Steak Cobb Salad
steps: Sear steak; rest; slice. Boil eggs; crisp bacon.
Whisk oil, vinegar, Dijon.
Arrange over romaine; dressing.

name: Chickpea Feta Cucumber Salad
steps: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, onion, dill.
Dress with lemon, oil, salt.
Feta.

name: Thai Chicken Zoodle Salad
steps: Whisk peanut butter, lime, tamari, ginger, sriracha, water.
Toss zoodles, carrot, cabbage, chicken, cilantro with dressing.
Peanuts.

name: Avocado Shrimp Chopped Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp; cool.
Chop vegetables.
Toss with lemon, oil, dill, salt; add shrimp.

name: Lentil Beet & Goat Cheese Salad
steps: Whisk oil, balsamic, Dijon.
Toss lentils, diced beet, arugula with dressing.
Goat cheese, walnuts.

name: Turkey Cobb Lettuce Bowl
steps: Boil eggs; crisp bacon.
Mix yogurt, ranch seasoning, lemon.
Arrange over romaine; dressing.

name: Edamame Avocado Salad with Lime
steps: Combine edamame, avocado, cucumber, tomato, cilantro.
Dress with lime, sesame oil, tamari.
Sesame seeds.

name: Grilled Chicken & Peach Arugula Salad
steps: Grill chicken; slice. Grill peach halves 2 minutes.
Toss arugula with oil and balsamic.
Top chicken, peach, goat cheese, almonds, basil.

name: Chicken Vegetable Quinoa Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic in oil.
Add broth and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add zucchini and cooked quinoa 5 minutes; parsley.

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup with White Beans
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with basil; stir in yogurt; salt.

name: Beef & Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown beef cubes in oil; add onion, carrot, celery, garlic.
Add broth, tomatoes, thyme, bay; simmer 60 minutes.
Add green beans and zucchini 8 minutes.

name: Zucchini Chicken Meatball Soup
steps: Mix chicken, egg, parmesan, almond flour, garlic; form small meatballs.
Sauté onion and carrot; add broth and seasoning; simmer; drop in meatballs 12 minutes.
Add zucchini and spinach 4 minutes.

name: Shrimp & Vegetable Miso Soup
steps: Simmer broth with ginger and mushrooms 5 minutes; add bok choy and tofu.
Add shrimp 3 minutes.
Whisk in miso off heat; green onion, sesame oil.

name: Lentil Kale Soup with Lemon
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, garlic, cumin in oil.
Add lentils and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Add kale 5 minutes; lemon, salt.

name: Turkey Taco Soup
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add seasoning.
Add beans, tomatoes, broth, corn, chiles; simmer 20 minutes.
Cheddar, yogurt, cilantro.

name: Cauliflower Curry Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder in oil.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes; blend.
Stir in coconut milk and chickpeas; lime, cilantro.

name: Chicken, Kale & White Bean Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add broth and chicken; simmer 15 minutes; shred.
Add beans and kale 5 minutes.
Parmesan, pepper flakes, lemon.

name: Salmon Miso Soup Bowl
steps: Simmer broth with ginger and shiitake 5 minutes; add bok choy and rinsed shirataki.
Add salmon chunks 4 minutes.
Miso off heat; green onion.

name: Mexican Chicken Lime Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, jalapeño, cumin in oil.
Add broth, tomato, chicken; simmer 18 minutes; shred.
Lime juice, cilantro, avocado.

name: White Bean Rosemary Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, rosemary in oil.
Add beans and broth; simmer 15 minutes; blend half.
Lemon, parmesan, salt.

name: Roasted Garlic Chicken Thighs with Broccolini
steps: Rub chicken with oil, garlic, rosemary, salt; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Add broccolini tossed in oil and pepper flakes; roast 10 minutes more.
Squeeze lemon over everything.
